summary: Entravision Communications filed an 8-K on October 6, 2026, reporting an Extension Amendment to its Station Affiliation Agreement with TelevisaUnivision affiliates, effective September 30, 2026. The amendment extends the affiliation term from December 31, 2026 to March 31, 2027, with automatic three-month renewals unless either party gives 30 days' non-renewal notice; related proxy and marketing/sales agreements are extended on identical terms. TelevisaUnivision holds roughly 10% of Entravision common stock on a fully converted basis. No price, premium, board recommendation, or advisor is stated; this is a routine commercial contract extension, not a special situation, and no deal terms are disclosed.
